lifetimeEvidence.criterion: User-approved documentary independence benchmark. The ICOMOS 2008 evaluation identifies a document dated 1296 as the first attesting San Marino independence and describes independent city-state formation in the thirteenth century. This does not establish that independence actually began in 1296; earlier communal institutions and the gradual development of autonomy are retained in the evidence. Neither the legendary 301 foundation nor the 885 community attestation is treated as a verified independent-state founding date.
